scope: Gameplay reference search includes concrete game procedures, calculations, definitions, restrictions and effects. Standalone non-mechanical introductions, setting/history, flavour descriptions and general storytelling advice are excluded from Rules. Standalone NPC/creature profiles and templates are excluded by user request, with reviewed NPC source records retained for possible future use. Setting-only prose, adventure scenes and secrets are excluded. Existing adapted character-creation profiles remain. This inventory audits selected gameplay ranges, not every sentence in the PDFs.
